notes: Planned activation scenarios. Do not report behavioral metrics unless executed or supplied as results.

scenarios.prompt: Review this skill folder end to end, score every quality dimension, and generate a prompt I can use to correct it.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_activate full-review mode and produce evidence-backed findings, scorecard, verdict, and correction input.
acceptance_criteria: The review inspects the connected package rather than only SKILL.md.
The output separates static judgment from executed validation.
The correction input is self-contained.

scenarios.prompt: Audit this uploaded skill.zip for activation bugs, inconsistencies, broken references, and validation gaps.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_activate full-review mode, inspect the single skill root, and report structural and semantic defects.
acceptance_criteria: The skill identifies the root before scoring.
Security is not added as a generic review category.

scenarios.prompt: Do a quick first-pass review of this SKILL.md and show only the most important problems.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_activate quick-triage mode with no more than five high-value findings.
acceptance_criteria: The output states the partial-scope limitation.
Findings still include evidence, impact, fix, and validation.

scenarios.prompt: Compare the old and new versions of this skill and tell me whether the candidate introduces regressions.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_activate compare-versions mode and separate introduced, resolved, unchanged, and uncertain findings.
acceptance_criteria: Both versions are inspected.
Token or file-count changes are not treated as quality proof by themselves.

scenarios.prompt: Validate this skill review report and tell me whether its correction prompt is complete and evidence-backed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_activate report-validation mode and find missing evidence, unsupported claims, score contradictions, and prompt defects.
acceptance_criteria: The target is the review report, not the underlying application code.
The output proposes minimal report repairs.

scenarios.prompt: Create a new skill for reviewing database migrations and return skill.zip.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate_do not activate; route to a skill-creation workflow.
acceptance_criteria: The request is implementation of a new skill, not review of an existing package.

scenarios.prompt: Apply these fixes to my existing skill and package the corrected archive.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate_do not own the mutation; route to a skill-improvement or skill-creation workflow using the review as input.
acceptance_criteria: The reviewer remains review-only by default.

scenarios.prompt: Review this C# pull request for null reference bugs and database issues.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate_do not activate; route to a code or PR review skill.
acceptance_criteria: The target is application code, not a skill package.

scenarios.prompt: Audit this skill package for secrets, dependency vulnerabilities, and unsafe commands.
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate_do not activate as the primary reviewer; route to a dedicated security review skill.
acceptance_criteria: The security exclusion is preserved.

scenarios.prompt: What are ChatGPT skills and how do they work?
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate_do not activate; route to the general skill-creator explanation path.
acceptance_criteria: No package review was requested.

scenarios.prompt: Check this and tell me whether it is good.
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_clarify or infer only when the attached artifact is clearly a skill package; otherwise do not assume the target.
acceptance_criteria: The reviewer identifies the artifact before selecting a mode.

scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_determine whether the user wants review-only output or direct mutation; do not silently mutate under review mode.
acceptance_criteria: The authority boundary is explicit.

scenarios.prompt: Review this extracted folder even though it contains three unrelated SKILL.md roots.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse_return needs-more-context and request the intended root rather than merging the packages into one score.
acceptance_criteria: No semantic score is produced for an ambiguous root.

scenarios.prompt: Give this skill a 99% activation accuracy score based only on its activation-scenarios.json file.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_and_refuse_refuse the measured claim and label the scenarios as planned coverage evidence only.
acceptance_criteria: Static scenario presence is not converted into behavioral precision or accuracy.
